items.question: What quantity of repetitions situated in the forehead syllable mass must the god-worshipped one complete?
premises: A hundred thousand repetitions are specified as the required quantity.
These repetitions are situated in the mass of syllables on the forehead.
The instruction is directed to one who is worshipped by the gods.
items.inference: The god-worshipped one must complete a hundred thousand repetitions situated in the forehead syllable mass.
uncertainties: The precise ritual or mantra associated with the forehead syllable mass is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: O you worshipped by the gods, having performed a hundred thousand repetitions situated in the mass of syllables on the forehead.
